summary: AUDIOCODES LTD filed a Form 6-K on May 5, 2026, attaching a press release announcing Q1 2026 financial results and a share buyback program. The filing reports quarterly revenues of $62.1M (up 2.9% YoY), GAAP net income of $2.0M ($0.07/diluted share), and the repurchase of 1,740,329 shares for $13.7M during the quarter. No special-situation event (e.g., acquisition, activist campaign, tender offer) is described; the buyback is a routine capital return. Filing is an earnings release with standard buyback disclosure, not a transformative corporate action. No deal terms are provided. What to watch: typical earnings reaction; no risk-arb angle.
